subject: Workshop transport playbook: shuttle slots, rentals & venue parking
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@summit-shuttles.com>, concierge@grandplaza.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Jessica Mendez <jessica.mendez@clientco.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Workshop transport playbook: shuttle slots, rentals & venue parking

Hi Tara / Grand Plaza team,

We're finalizing ground transport for the ClientCo onsite workshop on July 14–15 (30 attendees + 6 execs). Quick ask: can Summit provide a consolidated playbook covering the following by EOD Friday?

- Shuttle run plan for morning arrival (airport -> hotel -> venue) with 4 time slots between 7:30–9:30am
- Dedicated executive towncar availability (2x SUVs reserved for exec pickups and on-demand transfers)
- Short-term rental options for a small field team (3 vehicles, daily rates)
- Venue parking passes and drop-off/pickup staging (valet vs. self-park)

We need estimated costs, lead times, and any depot/driver arrival windows so we can include in the attendee logistics memo. Laura — happy for you to own attendee-facing timing once we have slots. Jonas — please confirm if we should include a van for AV gear.

Attachments: I uploaded the venue map to the shared doc (link below).

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Events Program Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: none (see follow-up from vendor)

From: Tara Singh <tara@summit-shuttles.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, concierge@grandplaza.com

Subject: Re: Workshop transport playbook: shuttle slots, rentals & venue parking

Hi Rachel / team,

Thanks — attaching our Fleet Options PDF and a preliminary rate sheet. High-level answers below, happy to jump on a quick call if you prefer.

1) Shuttle plan (recommended):
- 4x 14-seat minibuses. Proposed pickup windows from SFO: 7:30am, 8:00am, 8:30am, 9:00am.
- Each run: airport -> Redwood Hotel -> Grand Plaza (venue). Total transit + staggered drop-offs ~55–75 minutes depending on traffic.
- On-site liaison included for a one-time fee.

2) Executive cars:
- 2x SUV (black) dedicated for 14 July 7:00am–20:00. Drivers vetted, company insured. Hourly as well as flat-day rate available.

3) Rentals for crew:
- 3x compact SUVs available through our partner rental pool; daily rate included in rate sheet. Fuel/insurance options either self-pay or billed through Summit.

4) Parking & staging:
- Grand Plaza has a valet lane and a separate vendor load-in zone. Valet passes: $20/pass/day; vendor staging requires a 15-minute pre-book window for unloading. See attached parking map from venue.

Pricing notes: shuttle per-run pricing scaled for weekend vs. weekday; discounts available for multi-day bookings. Lead time: we can confirm fleet and drivers with a 10-business-day notice for partial hold, full confirmation needs 5 business days.

Attachments: SummitShuttles_FleetOptions.pdf (fleet breakdown), Summit_RateSheet_July2026.xlsx (rate table).

Let me know if you'd like me to block slots tentatively; I can hold without deposit for 48 hours.

Best,
Tara Singh
Operations Manager
Summit Shuttles

Attachments: SummitShuttles_FleetOptions.pdf; Summit_RateSheet_July2026.xlsx

Rachel / Tara —

Thanks for the options, Tara. A couple of quick calls outs:
- Please include one 15-ft cargo van option on the rental side for AV gear (we'll probably need it for the demo racks). If that's not available via Summit's partner pool, I'll source locally.
- For the executive cars: request drivers carry guest contact numbers and a printed manifest with flight numbers — helps for late arrivals.
- For parking: recommend we secure 6 VIP valet passes for execs and sponsors; attendees should use the shuttle.

Tara — can you tentatively block 2 SUVs and the 4 shuttle slots for 48 hours? If so we'll route deposit/PO through procurement.

Thanks,
Jonas

Perfect — thanks everyone. Confirming decisions and next steps (action items):

1) Tentative holds (Tara) — thank you for holding for 48 hours: 4x 14-seat shuttles (7:30/8:00/8:30/9:00), 2x executive SUVs (full-day 14 July), 3x crew rentals + 1x 15-ft cargo van.
2) Parking (Grand Plaza) — please confirm 6 VIP valet passes and vendor 15-minute staging windows. Grand Plaza, please add the passes to the master event account and confirm whether they need license plate numbers in advance.
3) Procurement / billing — Jonas: we'll route the deposit request and vendor PO through procurement today; Tara, please provide an invoice template and payment terms for Redwood (Net 30 preferred).
4) Attendee comms — Laura: once Tara confirms the final pick-up windows and shuttle boarding location at the hotel, please draft the attendee logistics email; I'll review. Jessica: we'll include an exec contact card for late arrivals.

I'll attach the Fleet Options and the venue parking map to the shared workshop playbook (link in metadata). Tara — if you can send the invoice template and confirm hold in the next 6 hours, we can keep these slots.

Thanks —
Rachel
